name: Kasa EP40 Outdoor Plug (US)

matter.note: Neither the Kasa page nor the datasheet mentions Matter; absence is not a no. The separate EP40M is the Matter model.

apple_home.note: The EP40's Kasa page and datasheet list Alexa and Google Assistant only. The EP40A variant lists Apple Home, but that is a different model.

google_home.note: Works with Google Assistant through the Kasa app link.

alexa.note: Works with Alexa through the Kasa skill.

smartthings.note: Not on the EP40 Kasa page or datasheet; the separate EP40A page lists SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: Listed under power strips in the official TP-Link Smart Home integration, which talks to Kasa devices locally.

hubRequired.note: No hub required; needs the free Kasa Smart app and an account.

localControl.note: Home Assistant's integration connects locally without the TP-Link cloud. Kasa's own app and voice control use the cloud.

energyMonitoring.note: Neither the Kasa page nor the datasheet mentions energy monitoring.

maxLoadWatts.note: TP-Link states 1.875 kW maximum power and 15 A total, shared across both outlets; the Kasa page adds a 1/2 HP motor rating.

summary: Kasa EP40 outdoor plug: Alexa and Google Assistant through the Kasa app, plus Home Assistant's TP-Link integration, with no hub. It connects over 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only and supports 15 A (1,875 W) shared across both outlets. Apple Home isn't listed for this model.
caveats: The 15 A (1,875 W) limit is shared by both outlets.
Apple Home and SmartThings are listed only for the separate EP40A model.
